integrity: Analytic proof supplied in full; the finite exact checker supplements, not replaces, the argument. No external scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The comparison is between projection tests and one specific sufficient jointly Gaussian block certificate. It does not prove a failure of full multivariate convex order.
Only equal-weight simplex rank-one components and centred isotropic Gaussian targets are covered.
Some historically plausible source bodies were inaccessible; priority is not independently verified.
title: Sharp simplex gap between projected Gaussian convex order and Gaussian-block certificates
